title.zh: SK海力士计划2026年向股东返还约100万亿韩元，拟回购并注销逾60万亿韩元股份
title.en: SK海力士计划2026年向股东返还约100万亿韩元，拟回购并注销逾60万亿韩元股份

current_state.zh: SK Hynix plans to return about 100 trillion KRW to shareholders in 2026, including over 60 trillion KRW in share buybacks and cancellation and more than 30 trillion KRW in cash dividends, as Q3 DRAM average selling prices rose over 20% quarter-over-quarter.
current_state.en: SK Hynix plans to return about 100 trillion KRW to shareholders in 2026, including over 60 trillion KRW in share buybacks and cancellation and more than 30 trillion KRW in cash dividends, as Q3 DRAM average selling prices rose over 20% quarter-over-quarter.
